repo.name: Kural Heart
repo.description: The official F-Droid repository for Kural Heart, a private Android journal with Thiruvalluvar: one Thirukkural couplet a day, a question it asks of you, and a page that stays on your phone. Same signed APKs as the GitHub releases.

apps.description:
Kural Heart is a quiet journal with Thiruvalluvar. Each day brings one couplet of the
Thirukkural on its palm leaf, in Tamil and English, with a question to write about and a
private page that stays on your phone.

* All 1,330 couplets, with a pronunciation line under each, simple or scholarly (ISO 15919)
* V. V. S. Aiyar's English (1916), G. U. Pope's verse and prose (1886), and
  Mu. Varadarasanar's Tamil explanation under every couplet
* A short "For daily life" note on living each couplet today
* Listen: each couplet read aloud in your phone's Tamil voice, then the English
* A question for the mind, for speech and for action, from every chapter
* Write with photos, a voice note, a short video, a feeling, the place and the weather
* Find your pages by day, by feeling, in a calendar, with your photos, or on a map
* A thread, not a streak: two rest days a week are kept for you, and nine seals mark the way
* Share any couplet as a story or a post, in seven looks from Tamil life
* Ivory or Midnight, English or Tamil, a Today widget and a gentle daily reminder
* No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your pages are encrypted on your phone;
  backups are one file locked with a passphrase only you know, in a folder you choose or in
  a hidden app folder in your own Google Drive

The Tamil text is Project Madurai's, checked line by line against two other sources. English
from Standard Ebooks and Project Madurai; Mu. Varadarasanar's explanation from Tamil Wikisource.

Privacy policy: https://inigo-code.github.io/kural-heart-site/privacy.html
